name: ak
description: Evidence-backed delivery with typed requirements, TDD, G0-G9 structural gates, and C1-C8 semantic audit.

interface.shortDescription: Clear-spec gated delivery for multi-repo projects
interface.longDescription: Learn domain, clarify specs, clarify-check against running code, plan/TDD/build with evidence maps, confirm with How/By, and enforce gates via check-gates.sh. Works across multiple project workspaces.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use ak to route this ticket through the first failing evidence gate. Do not invent PASS or human confirmation.
